senses.gloss:
€1P. 
__1 To pass out of (water), disembark, come out of; उत्तेरे तरलतरङ्गरङ्गलीलानिष्णातैरथ सरसः प्रियासमूहैः [[Śi. 8. 63]], 64; to get or jump out of, rise from; 12. 31; पल्वलोत्तीर्ण [[R. 2. 17]]; अभिषेकोत्तीर्णाय, स्नानोत्तीर्णः [[Ś. 4.]] 
__2 To cross, pass or get over (a river &c.); उदतारिषुरम्भोधिम् [[Bk. 15. 33]], 10; शोकसागरमुत्तीर्य [[Ve. 3]]; तेनोत्तीर्य पथा [[R. 12. 71]], 16. 33; [[Me. 49.]] 
__3 To vanquish, overcome, get out of, escape from (a difficulty); व्यसनमहार्णवादपारादुत्तीर्णम् [[Mk. 10. 49.]] 
__4 To descend, alight; तद्गृहे उत्तीर्णौ [[Vet.]] 
__5 To give up, leave, quit. 
__6 To raise, strengthen, increase. -Caus. 
__1 To cause to come out, deliver, lift up, rescue; जलनिधिजलमध्यादेष उत्तार्यतेऽर्कः [[Śi. 11. 44.]]; [[Dk. 30]], 77. 
__2 To take down, to take off (as ornaments); let down, place down. 
__3 To cause to cross over, [Page0410-2] convey, transport across. 
__4 To land, disembark. 
__5 To vomit up, emit.
